chose: The beat names its role as an optional field, checked per character in the cut list's schema; a beat with none is the character's everyday self and draws exactly as before, so the cast-v1 design keeps its name. A change of role on the next beat cuts to the new look while the emotion's loop carries on; the costume joins the figure, so it moves with every loop's pose. Rendering stays a pure function of the beat, the seed and t, pinned by hash.
